claims.claim: DPR's Wikipedia retrieval corpus contains 21,015,324 passages.
Passages were built from the English Wikipedia dump from Dec 20, 2018.
DrQA preprocessing code was used to clean the data.
Tables, infoboxes, lists, and disambiguation pages were removed.
Each article was split into disjoint 100-word text blocks.
Each passage is prefixed with the article's title.
Each passage is prefixed with an [SEP] token.
